svg.title: Repo Agent architecture
svg.desc: Animated diagram of the coding agent: indexing GitLab repos and coding standards into MongoDB Atlas with Voyage voyage-code-4 embeddings, answering developer questions from Continue.dev via permission-filtered hybrid search and OpenAI, and monitoring usage in a console.

g.text: embed query → $vectorSearch ∥ $search, both pre-filtered on access_scope
→ reciprocal-rank fusion → Voyage rerank → top-k code + 1–3 standard clauses
Bearer token → user, team, access scopes (config/users.yaml)
Metadata per chunk: repo, branch, path,
API key stays on the server
I1 Read repositories from GitLab (read-only token)
I2 Read the coding standard, one chunk per clause
I3 Embed changed chunks with voyage-code-4
I4 Upsert chunks + vector/text indexes in Atlas
R1 Developer asks in Continue (token = identity)
R5 Grounded prompt with [S#] sources to OpenAI
R6 Stream answer with citations back to the IDE
R7 Developer reviews and applies the diff
R8 Agent-mode tools over /mcp, same permissions
M1 Accept / reject outcomes from Continue
M2 Usage events + hourly rollups into Atlas
M3 Admin opens the monitoring console

svg.text: Continue.dev · MongoDB Atlas · Voyage AI · OpenAI
